2.15.24
Subreport.NoRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Subreport.NoRows element indicates the message to display in the place of a Subreport when
no rows of data are available in any DataSet that is used in the body of the subreport. This element is
optional. If this element is specified, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or
an expression that evaluates to a String. Style information MUST apply to this text.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.NoRows element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.NoRows element.
 <xsd:element name="NoRows" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
